description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency values consistently across an application. It includes methods for formatting amounts with dynamic decimal precision, appending optional credits, and handling special formatting for USD currency. The functions support formatting numeric input (including strings), applying locale-aware formatting, and optional inclusion of credits based on a fixed conversion rate.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with dynamic precision, optional inclusion of credits, and fallback handling for invalid inputs.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function that formats USD amount with appended credits information if valid.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats USD values with up to six decimal places, including thousands separators.
